% IEEEtran journal template wrapper. All content comes from build/*.tex,
% generated by ../common/md2tex.py from the Markdown manuscript.
\documentclass[journal]{IEEEtran}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{newtxtext,newtxmath}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{mdcommon}
\usepackage{cite}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\hyphenation{bio-hybrid}
\input{build/meta.tex}

\newenvironment{keypointsbox}{%
  \begin{tcolorbox}[colback=black!4,colframe=black!55,boxrule=0.4pt,arc=0pt,
    left=3pt,right=3pt,top=2pt,bottom=2pt,
    title={\footnotesize\bfseries KEY POINTS},fonttitle=\footnotesize\bfseries,
    coltitle=white,colbacktitle=black!65,boxsep=1pt]
  \footnotesize\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}%
}{\end{tcolorbox}}

\begin{document}
\title{\PaperTitle}
\author{%
  \IEEEauthorblockN{\PaperAuthors}\\
  \IEEEauthorblockA{\PaperAffiliations}
  \thanks{\PaperManuscriptNote}%
  \thanks{\PaperAuthorNotes}%
}
\maketitle

\ifpaperabstract
\begin{abstract}
\input{build/abstract.tex}
\end{abstract}
\fi

\ifpaperkeywords
\begin{IEEEkeywords}
\input{build/keywords.tex}
\end{IEEEkeywords}
\fi

\ifpaperkeypoints
\begin{keypointsbox}
\input{build/keypoints.tex}
\end{keypointsbox}
\fi

\input{build/body.tex}

\bibliographystyle{IEEEtran}
\bibliography{build/references}

\ifpaperappendix
\appendix[Supplementary figures]
\setcounter{figure}{0}
\renewcommand{\thefigure}{S\arabic{figure}}
\input{build/appendix.tex}
\fi
\end{document}
